entries.en: Look, I know it's your big premiere, but I really can't. They're making me stay late today.
entries.ro: Uite, știu că e premiera ta mare, dar chiar nu pot. Mă obligă să stau peste program azi.

entries.en: Honey, why would I lie to you?
Oh, I'm selfish? Mhm, right. What do you want from me? You want me to quit my job?!
entries.ro: A, deci sunt egoist? Mhm, da. Ce vrei de la mine, să-mi dau demisia?!

entries.en: "Not what you meant."? Well, that's what it would mean. You like that Japantown apartment, right? You think your little theater's paying for it?
entries.ro: „Nu asta ai vrut să spui.”? Păi, asta ar veni să zică. Îți place apartamentul ăla din Japantown, nu? Crezi că teatrul tău de doi bani îl plătește?

entries.en: Mhm... Look, I'm sorry... Hello? Hello?
entries.ro: Mhm... Uite, îmi pare rău... Alo? Alo?
